newsitem.title: JAPAN: INSIGHT - Japan stocks' April SQ seen smooth.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Japan stocks' April SQ seen smooth.

text.p: The settlement of Japan's April stock options, called special quotations (SQ), on Friday is likely to go smoothly, and the impact on cash stocks should be limited, traders said on Thursday.
Open interest for the April contract stands at a relatively low level, with the amount of net sales slightly outnumbering that of net purchases, they said.
The net sales per component of the 225-share Nikkei average, the stock market's key index, is expected to be around 100,000 shares at most, they added.
"The market conditions are quite comfortable for stock prices right now," said a futures trader at a medium-sized securities house.
"Cash stocks are likely to see slight net sales per issue, as is the case for the Nikkei 225 issues," said a futures and options trader at a major securities house.
"We expect sales to amount to 40,000 to 50,000 shares," said a trader at a foreign securities house.
